element: Before/Now gradient tiles over conversion rows
what_it_does: Shows a model shift as two gradient tiles of what the product covered, above rows that convert each old term into its new one.
how_built: Two equal dark-to-teal gradient rectangles titled Antes/Hoje with diamond-bullet lists; below, two icon headers and two rows of hard-shadow outlined chips joined by short arrows (Licenciamento to SaaS, Infraestrutura to PaaS).
use_for: Business model transitions, on-prem to cloud, licence to subscription.

element: Acronym spoke hub around a pictogram
what_it_does: Defines a product suite by putting the buyer in the middle and eight acronyms on thin spokes around it.
how_built: Central building pictogram; eight bold 18pt acronyms in a circle with a one-line grey gloss under each; hairline spokes stop short of both the picture and the label; no boxes at all.
use_for: Module maps, product portfolio, segments served by one platform.

element: Core and Near Core twin rings with fanned product notes
what_it_does: Sorts products into two tiers by giving each tier a ringed object with fan lines out to its products on both sides.
how_built: Two rings stacked vertically, each with a cube icon and a label above (Core, Near Core); from each ring, two or four thin angled lines fan left and right to small text blocks with a green product title.
use_for: Core versus adjacent portfolio, business lines with different maturity.

element: Count beads on a year rail
what_it_does: Turns an M&A plan into a rail of circled deal counts with years alternating above and below.
how_built: Horizontal hairline running off the slide edge; five equal grey outlined circles with a large digit; year labels in bold teal alternate above and below the beads.
use_for: Planned deals per year, roll-out counts, store openings by year.

element: Tinted pentagon summary field pointing into rationale
what_it_does: Splits a one-page investment summary into a tinted facts zone whose right edge points at the white reasoning zone.
how_built: Pale pink freeform covers the left 60 percent and ends in a shallow chevron nose; facts and thesis sit centred on it, while Entry, Exit and Risks sit on white to the right as diamond-bulleted rows of small cards.
use_for: Investment summary, one-page memo, IC-style overview.

element: Diamond return rail from IRR to MOIC
what_it_does: Draws the holding period as a vertical line whose two ends carry the two return numbers.
how_built: Thin vertical magenta line with a diamond at each end; IRR above the top diamond, MOIC under the bottom one, and 'In 6 years' interrupting the line at mid-height.
use_for: Return summary for a private deal or a holding-period thesis.

element: Capsule columns with icon disc and logo stack
what_it_does: Presents portfolio segments as tall rounded capsules where the stacked brands under each label prove the claim.
how_built: Five tall stadium outlines in tints of the brand colour; a filled icon disc sits at the top of each, then a bold label, a small italic descriptor, a short rule and three or four monochrome logos stacked in the lower half.
use_for: Brand portfolios, segment architecture, ecosystem of products.

element: Option chain with fading pills and cards
what_it_does: Shows staged real options left to right with colour strength falling as each option gets more conditional.
how_built: Row of four pills (Now, If X validates, Separate option) over four rounded outline cards with a filled value chip at the base; the fill goes magenta, tint, teal, grey to encode rising conditionality.
use_for: Expansion plans, staged capex, optionality slices of value.

element: J-curve with asset illustration pinned at breakeven
what_it_does: Annotates the cash curve with its trough and payoff and parks a picture of the asset where it crosses zero.
how_built: Dotted line with round markers over a thin zero axis; rounded tinted callouts for Max risk and Upside on hook leaders; a vertical bar flag marks the payback year; an isometric building overlaps the curve on the right.
use_for: Single-project payback, new-unit economics, greenfield capex.

element: Numbered chain header driving one row per step
what_it_does: Uses a thin numbered chain as a header and hangs one sentence and one logo set from each step.
how_built: Four small dashed numbered tiles on a dashed line with step names under them; below, four outlined rows numbered 1 to 4, each with a sentence on the left and an icon or logo cell on the right.
use_for: Supply chain with players at each stage.

element: KPI bubble cluster with loose droplets
what_it_does: Replaces a KPI row with a loose cluster of soft circles of different sizes, with small empty droplets as texture.
how_built: Three or four pale green circles of varied size holding a number and caption, overlapping nothing; six to ten small empty circles of the same tint scattered around them in free positions.
use_for: Footprint or scale KPIs where a table would feel flat.

element: Slanted two-tone How-it-works band
what_it_does: Divides a mechanism note from its assumptions with a band whose fill ends on a diagonal.
how_built: Full-width thin band; left 55 percent in mint, ending in a slanted edge, with bold question and two lines; right part pale grey with a dashed vertical and italic assumptions.
use_for: Mechanism plus assumptions under a structure diagram.

element: Staged deal columns closing on a final structure panel
what_it_does: Summarises a multi-step transaction as bordered columns with big stats, chevrons between them and the end-state org chart as the last panel.
how_built: On dark, three neon-green-outlined columns each holding two numbered steps with a large stat per step, and thin chevrons in the gutters; a fourth wider column holds the final structure chart; assumptions run in a footer.
use_for: Transaction summary, multi-stage deal or restructuring recap.

element: Logo treemap zoomed out from a sliver into a second treemap
what_it_does: Shows the dominant player's treemap, then opens its tiny remainder into a second treemap of the niche.
how_built: Left treemap with one giant tile filled with a ghosted logo; the narrow right tiles are joined by a grey trapezoid wall to a second treemap, whose tiles use full logos as the only labels; tile colours step from dark to light.
use_for: Market share where the niche is invisible beside the incumbent.

element: Stepped lifecycle silhouette with numbered phase key
what_it_does: Draws an asset's cash profile as a blocky silhouette split by who owns each phase, keyed to numbered tiles.
how_built: Stepped polygon around a cash-flow axis, with phase digits inside each block and two colours for the two owners; headers 'Incumbent focus' and 'Niche focus' above; a 2-by-3 grid of dark rounded tiles lists the numbered phase names.
use_for: Asset lifecycle, where the company plays in the life of a well, plant or product.

element: Spine timeline with alternating notched banners
what_it_does: Tells a financing history down a vertical spine with date banners flagging out to alternating sides.
how_built: Dark vertical line in a pale grey panel; dark, then one light, swallowtail banners holding the date, leaving the line left or right; bold amount and label beneath each banner; a tinted header pill sits on the panel top.
use_for: Debt raises, M&A history, funding rounds.

element: Numbered badges on radar vertices keyed to a list
what_it_does: Removes axis labels from a radar and uses numbered badges at the vertices that map to a scored list.
how_built: Hairline concentric pentagons with a single coloured polygon; dark pentagon badges with a white digit float outside each vertex; the right panel repeats the same badges beside a bold force name with its score and a short paragraph.
use_for: Porter forces, scorecards with long criterion text.

element: KPI satellite dots on a faint orbit
what_it_does: Places claims as solid dots on a barely visible ring around the logo, each with a short caps label.
how_built: Pale grey central disc with logo; very pale wide ring around it; five solid brand-colour dots on the ring with caps text outside; on the left, a large coloured name is linked to the disc by a hook line.
use_for: Product-at-a-glance, attributes of one business unit.

element: Nested TAM circles with tabbed leaders
what_it_does: Nests the addressable market inside the total with circles tangent at the base, each tied to a side label.
how_built: Two circles sharing a bottom tangent in pale and stronger yellow, value inside each near its top; horizontal leaders run to labels with a short vertical colour tab.
use_for: TAM and SAM with a large size gap.

element: Off-page progress arcs keyed to a numbered list
what_it_does: Shows several progress scores as concentric partial arcs bleeding off the left edge, one per list item.
how_built: Four concentric thick arcs cut by the slide's left margin, grey track with a yellow portion of different length; to the right, large thin numerals 01 to 04 with one line each.
use_for: Improvement areas, scorecards of initiatives.

element: Phase columns over a benefit area and effort curve
what_it_does: Aligns four programme phases to a rising benefit area and a falling effort line, with the actions under each phase.
how_built: Four dark header boxes spanning the width with a double arrow and duration under each; one yellow freeform area climbing across them with an S-curved black line crossing it and a triangular kickoff marker; bullets in columns aligned below.
use_for: Transformation programmes, roadmaps with a value build-up.

element: Long chain above short chain to show disintermediation
what_it_does: Stacks the traditional and direct chains on the same icon grid, so the missing steps show as empty space.
how_built: Grey panel; upper row of six line icons with chevrons, lower row of three icons spaced across the same width with chevrons; italic row labels and a two-line note beneath each row.
use_for: Channel disruption, removal of middlemen, direct versus indirect routes.

element: Acrostic drop-letter pillar cards
what_it_does: Makes three tall cards spell the framework through an oversized first letter in a contrasting colour.
how_built: Three full-height solid-colour cards with a line icon centred on top; heading with its first letter at 1.5 times size in dark, rest in white; chevron-bulleted list below.
use_for: ESG, or any framework named by an acronym.

element: Twin vertical chains with check and cross verdict rows
what_it_does: Compares two companies by running the same three-link chain side by side, with each link's consequence as a green check or a red cross row.
how_built: Each side has a logo plus a short incentive note, then three hard-shadow icon tiles stacked with arrows; to the right of each tile, a pale green row with a ringed check or a pale red row with a ringed cross; one chain uses double arrows, the other a broken elbow line.
use_for: Why an incentive or model works for one player and fails for its rival.

element: Logo pentagon constellation around a business unit
what_it_does: Shows what a unit contains by setting product logos on the corners of an outlined pentagon that names the unit in the middle.
how_built: Thin blue pentagon outline with caps text in the centre; a logo at each vertex, knocked over the line with the panel colour; above it, an old logo arrows into the new one to record the rebrand.
use_for: Group brands, digital unit composition, sub-brands of a holding.

element: Two-tone arc arrows as a two-engine flywheel
what_it_does: Draws mutual reinforcement as two huge opposed arc arrows, each owned by one business, around the company logo.
how_built: Two thick block-arc arrows, medium and dark, forming a full ring around a white logo disc with a hairline inner circle; a rectangular name tag sits on the left and right of the ring; four text blocks at the diagonals connect through hairlines with diamond ends.
use_for: Synergy between two segments, reinforcing loops with two engines.

element: Triangle-pointer process axis
what_it_does: Hangs step captions over a line with grey downward triangles ending in dots, closing on a bold result statement.
how_built: Pale grey strip; hairline axis with three solid dots; a short grey triangle drops from each caption to its dot, with the middle dot in dark colour; the last column is a bold conclusion and has no pointer.
use_for: Customer journey or mechanism summary under a diagram.

element: Mirror spines under a shared question bar
what_it_does: Sets two parties' benefits in mirrored columns with text aligned toward outer ring-bulleted spines.
how_built: Grey bar across the slide with a central question and a dark tab at each end naming the side; two vertical spine lines at the far left and far right; three thick ring bullets per spine; left text ragged right of its spine, right text right-aligned to its spine.
use_for: Two-sided value exchange, partnerships, platform with two user groups.

element: Serpentine era timeline with diamonds
what_it_does: Folds a timeline back on itself in one U-turn, so a long history stays large in half a slide.
how_built: One thick line going left to right, then a round U-turn to run right to left, ending in an arrowhead on the last date; outlined diamonds at each era with a large pale decade label and two-colour caption; the line fades from pale at the start to saturated at the end.
use_for: Industry history, eras next to a structural diagram.

element: Service stack with fee arrows to two clients
what_it_does: Shows a two-sided business as a vertical product stack with paired flow arrows out to the two customer groups.
how_built: Five stacked rows in shades of one blue under a dark header, framed in dark; to the right, paired arrows pointing opposite ways with service above and fee below in blue; each pair ends in an outlined pale green tile with a big icon and label.
use_for: How a bank or intermediary earns from each side.

element: Stake chips into target logo with board list attached
what_it_does: Combines ownership and control by hanging the target's board from the same diagram as its shareholders.
how_built: Three logos or grey tags in a row with small italic percent chips on the wires dropping to a large target logo; underneath, a pale panel split by a vertical rule with 'nominated by' at left and director names at right; a double-slash mark breaks the connector.
use_for: Joint ventures, minority stakes where board control matters.

element: Vertical value chain rail with icon and callout cards
what_it_does: Runs a value chain down a tinted side rail, so it can sit next to charts without taking their width.
how_built: Pale blue vertical panel with a header tab; three steps alternate a line icon and a small blue-outlined text box, joined by thin elbows; the rail closes with a dark conclusion box.
use_for: Sector primers that need a chain and charts on one page.

element: Wire globe with leaders to tiered activity rows
what_it_does: Shows a conglomerate as one network sphere, with three leader lines from its surface to labelled business rows.
how_built: Wireframe sphere built from lines and dots in the dark brand colour, cut by the left card; three straight leaders from three nodes pass a small bold segment label and end in a solid dot beside a one-line role description.
use_for: Group overview, holding segments, integrated businesses.

element: Step columns hanging from a ticked rail
what_it_does: Sets out a multi-step plan as a full-width rail crossed by short ticks, each dropping a column with rationale chips and bottom KPIs.
how_built: A thin line crosses the slide; a cross tick marks each of four columns with 'Nth Step' beside it; each column is a faint outlined panel with an italic title, two dashed chips and three stacked KPI lines. Reused later with three columns dimmed.
use_for: Action plans, deleveraging, multi-step recommendations.

element: Event timeline stacked over analog-case bars
what_it_does: Pairs the current case's dated events with a bar set of prior cases to answer how long this usually takes.
how_built: Upper band: arrowed axis with small tan ring nodes and arrow-capped stems alternating up and down to centred captions. Lower band: under a caps header and rule, four grey bars with brand and year labels, closed by a dashed vertical and a pale tan note.
use_for: Turnarounds, recoveries, base-rate arguments.

element: Segmented C-wheel with icon wedges around a title disc
what_it_does: Holds a culture statement in a ringed disc while a graded sweep of wedges counts the episodes told in the dark list beside it.
how_built: Thick grey ring with an italic title inside; around its right side, four ring segments going from grey to saturated red, each with a line icon; the dark panel to the right has numbered red 01-04 stories.
use_for: Track record, episodes of execution, milestones without dates.

element: SWOT cards with corner sashes around a quartered ring
what_it_does: Sets four grey cards around a logo ring, with the quadrant name as a diagonal sash on each outer corner.
how_built: Four pale grey cards with centred text and a gap between them; a thick quartered ring with the logo overlaps the inner corners, with red, pink and grey segments; each card has a diagonal 45-degree ribbon on the outer corner in its quadrant's colour, grey for threats.
use_for: SWOT, two-by-two lists with a clear good and bad reading.

element: Deadline columns ending in a darkening slanted band
what_it_does: Lays dated obligations in columns whose feet merge into one band that darkens with time and rises in steps.
how_built: Six grey-topped cards with a bold date and two short notes; below, one continuous row of colour blocks going from pale to navy, each with a white headline and a slanted top edge so the row climbs to the right.
use_for: Concession milestones, covenants, regulatory calendars.

element: Illustrated process chain with a risk row beneath
what_it_does: Draws each stage as a small 3D plant illustration in an arrowed chain, with a matched row of what can go wrong under each.
how_built: Seven same-angle isometric illustrations with thin arrows between them; a bold step name under each; below, two rows of short coloured risk labels with an icon bullet at the left, aligned to the same columns.
use_for: Operational chains where each stage has its own risk or cost.

element: Sorted bars with colour break and dashed average brackets
what_it_does: Turns a cost curve into an argument by changing bar colour at the break point and pinning each zone's average on a dashed bracket.
how_built: Ascending columns per percentile: grey to the break, then cyan deepening to navy; dashed elbow brackets rise from the zone edges to outlined average chips at different heights; a pale tinted note with a side rule fills the empty upper left.
use_for: Marginal cost, cost curves, cohort or asset ranking.

element: Age pyramids as paired solid vase silhouettes
what_it_does: Reduces two population pyramids to solid same-colour shapes, so the eye compares the silhouette and not the bars.
how_built: Back-to-back age bars with no gap and no axis, in a single green, with stepped ends left visible; two side by side labelled by year, with age bands listed only at the left of each.
use_for: Demographic shift, any distribution whose shape changed.

element: Group capsules linked by a dashed elbow with a multiple
what_it_does: Rings the top and bottom groups of a bar chart and links them with a dashed elbow labelled with the multiple.
how_built: Horizontal bars in a green-outlined panel; two rounded dashed tinted capsules around the chosen rows; dashed elbow from upper capsule, down the right side and back with an arrowhead to the lower; bold '4x more!' knocks through the line.
use_for: Top versus bottom cohort spending, concentration.

element: Profit pool Marimekko with share as width
what_it_does: Shows who earns the sector's profit, with spread as height and market share as width around a zero line.
how_built: Adjacent blocks along a zero axis: width is share and height is spread; the leader is a long thin green block above zero, the others hang below in sky and navy with heavy widths; value labels sit in tinted chips on the block edge.
use_for: Profit pools, value capture across players.

element: Charts as operands in a visual equation
what_it_does: Writes DuPont literally by placing whole charts as terms with large operators between them.
how_built: Grey band with a folded green tab title; three charts in a row with the same bar style and label pills; big black X and = sit in the gutters between the plots; the last term is a line chart in the result colour.
use_for: ROIC or ROE decomposition, any product of drivers over time.

element: Bevelled vertical WACC column with stacked operators
what_it_does: Writes a whole formula down one narrow column, so the term values read like a table and leave the page width to charts.
how_built: Pale panel with a green bevel top and thick green base; centred large coloured result, then alternating '=', 'X', '+' lines with bold term and value below each.
use_for: WACC, cost of capital, any multi-term formula beside a build-up chart.

element: Floating block build-ups for cost of capital
what_it_does: Builds a rate through solid bricks that float at their running level, with no connector lines, axes or gridlines.
how_built: Wide flat blocks with a dark-green rim and hard side shadow, placed at cumulative height; a negative term is a small dark block near the top; value inside the block top and name under the baseline.
use_for: Cost of debt or equity build-up, short bridges.

element: Value box branching through a dashed bracket
what_it_does: Breaks one big market size into its segments using a dashed box and a dashed comb bracket without any boxes on the leaves.
how_built: Dashed rectangle with a value in large blue; short dashed line to a dashed vertical; four dashed horizontals to plain text labels.
use_for: TAM composition, small breakdown in an overview card.

element: Before and after circles with growth text in the gap
what_it_does: Compares two years by size alone, with the delta as words between the two circles.
how_built: Two circles with year above in black: smaller navy, larger teal; value inside each in white; bold '+500 Million' centred in the gap; hairlines tangent to both circles form an open cone, with no arrow.
use_for: Population or market size, one-glance growth.

element: Dashed valuation frame with breakout header and result plates
what_it_does: Holds the EV-to-equity bridge in a dashed frame, with the header and target price plates breaking the frame's top and bottom edges.
how_built: Pale grey panel with a tinted corner tab; inside, a dashed rectangle; dark navy plate overlaps its top edge, teal plate overlaps its bottom edge; centred lines with a hairline before the total.
use_for: Valuation result next to sensitivity tables.

element: Numbered market columns with tangent-linked circles
what_it_does: Compares three addressable markets by growing a circle across three cards, with fine tangent lines joining the circles.
how_built: Three grey rounded column cards with numbered red discs and bold titles; a solid red circle of increasing size in the same row, hairlines joining their tops and bottoms across the gutter; a red label chip at each foot holds the company share.
use_for: TAM by geography with the company's share at each level.

element: Lit driver tree with crosses between siblings
what_it_does: Breaks revenue into drivers and colours only the branch the slide discusses, repeating the tree as a locator.
how_built: Red top plate with elbow connectors to two rectangles and a light X between them; a further level beneath; active boxes in red, inactive in grey with faded X; rounded corners and italic labels; reused on later slides with a different branch lit.
use_for: KPI trees, SSS decomposition, section locator.

element: Offset year staircase of paired actual and consensus bars
what_it_does: Stacks each year's actual and consensus as paired right-anchored bars, so the years step down like stairs.
how_built: Paired horizontal bars, navy over yellow, all ending at the right axis; each lower year is shorter, producing a staircase on the left edge; year labels at far right and a dashed italic takeaway in the empty lower left.
use_for: Beats versus consensus, plan versus realised.

element: Wave labels inside stacked area bands
what_it_does: Names each layer of a stacked area as a wave in plain words on the band, so the reader does not need the legend.
how_built: Three stacked area layers in black, navy and yellow on a grey card with a hard right wall; '1st wave', '2nd wave', '3rd wave' placed by hand at the right end of each band, at the height where it thickens.
use_for: Technology adoption waves, successive revenue layers.

element: Quadrant name chips inside a scatter
what_it_does: Marks the zones of a scatter with grey chips in large italic, colouring each country label to match its chip.
how_built: Plot with no gridlines; four to six pale grey rectangles with bold italic two-line text in the zone's colour placed in empty plot space; point labels use the same colour as their zone; repeated names mark split zones.
use_for: Country or peer segmentation without drawing quadrant lines.

element: Cohort lines with a vertical gradient legend
what_it_does: Colours many cohort lines by age and replaces the legend with one gradient bar labelled at both ends.
how_built: About 30 lines going from pale lilac in old cohorts to saturated purple in new; a slim vertical gradient rectangle in the empty right area, with the first and last cohort names at its ends.
use_for: Cohort analysis, vintages, anything with too many series to label.

element: Value ball on a rounded track with average divider
what_it_does: Shows a score per brand as a coloured stem and ball rising in a pale rounded track, with brand logos as labels.
how_built: Equal pale vertical capsules; a thin stem in each brand's colour with a ball at the value; number on top of the track; logo at the foot; a dashed vertical between the below-average and above-average groups with 'Média' on top.
use_for: NPS, ratings, any 0-100 score across many peers.

element: App-icon column headers with logo row heads
what_it_does: Uses recognisable icons as column names and competitor logos as row names, so the table reads with almost no words.
how_built: Navy header row where two cells hold only an app-store icon; first column is navy too, with white-boxed or reversed logos; body cells in light grey with bold centred values and thin black rules. Page 150 is the variant with grey banding and an empty corner cell.
use_for: Peer ratings, product feature comparison.

element: Check table split into two opposed blocks
what_it_does: Sorts rows so one option's checks form one solid block and the other's a second block, making exclusivity visible at a glance.
how_built: Two-tone purple header over zebra grey rows; rows sorted by owner of the data; heavy black checks in only one column per row, which produce a stepped diagonal; no crosses and no dashes.
use_for: Data access, features unique to each model.

element: Status column wired from table row into a chart
what_it_does: Uses a tinted condition column as a heat strip and connects the current row by a thin bracket line to the time-series windows beside it.
how_built: Light table with hairline header; last column is a continuous block in green tints with a cyan top cell for the row at issue; a cyan elbow runs from that cell across the gutter to a line chart with dashed tinted crisis windows.
use_for: Asset condition lists tied to a historical stress chart.

element: Curved brand panel over a duotone photo
what_it_does: Lets a large curved edge of solid brand colour take the right half of a photo, which is washed in the same hue.
how_built: Full-bleed photo of the brand's physical asset with a semi-transparent purple overlay; a solid purple shape with a large-radius curved left edge carries title, rule and subtitle; team names bottom right; repeated for later dividers.
use_for: Cover and matching section dividers when a real company photo exists.

element: Two-tone swoop cover with a tilted photo
what_it_does: Cuts a tilted photo with large organic red forms, so the brand signage appears through a window between them.
how_built: Rotated photo with a red tint; dark-red gradient blob on the left, a brighter wave across the base, both freeforms with very large radii; white title with an underline, small logos top left and authors bottom right.
use_for: Cover for multi-brand companies, photographic section openers.

element: Roman-numbered three-by-two chart grid
what_it_does: Fills a primer page with six small charts in three strict columns, each column headed by a numbered claim over a coloured rule.
how_built: Three equal columns; each opens with 'I.', 'II.', 'III.' plus a short claim in the accent colour over a thin rule; two rows of charts below, each with a small grey title and only one highlight colour; one dashed window as the single annotation.
use_for: Sector overview, dense at-a-glance pages.

element: Twin dotted-orbit hubs on a dark band
what_it_does: Draws the same six-spoke ecosystem around two rival logos so the viewer sees at once that both built the identical model.
how_built: Full-width charcoal band; in each half two concentric dotted white circles, central logo on a white disc, six solid white discs sitting on the outer orbit, each with a short white rule ending in a dot and an italic coloured label; duplicate the group exactly and only swap the logo; stacked-share chart underneath on white.
use_for: Peer precedents, showing two companies converged on the same product set, international analogues

element: Three schematic g-curves over dashed stage boxes
what_it_does: Explains a model choice with three hand-drawn textbook axes, each locked to a dashed box holding the number that stage uses.
how_built: Three small arrow-headed L-axes built from lines, labelled g and t; black stepped polyline per regime; bold centred caption inside each plot; under each a dashed rectangle with stage label, large coloured % and italic note; grey field behind everything; quote strip below.
use_for: Justifying DCF stages, model-method slides, any concept where a schematic beats real data

element: Roof-top plates under persona icons with a logo sum between
what_it_does: Gives each side of a two-sided market its own benefit plate whose peak points up at its persona icon, with the combined products as a sum in the centre.
how_built: Light-grey pentagon shape like a house (very shallow roof) with bullets inside; line icon centred above the peak with a bold label; thick navy arrow from one icon to the other; in the centre gutter two logos stacked with a bold plus between.
use_for: Two-sided platforms, buyer vs seller benefits, value proposition by stakeholder

element: Thick-rim icon wheel with a throat into a revenue panel
what_it_does: Turns a business-line wheel into a lid that pours through a tinted throat into the donut showing what those lines earn.
how_built: Heavy brand-coloured ring, white spoke dividers, six equal tinted wedges each with a line icon and bold label, logo on a white centre disc; pale trapezoid from the wheel's lower edge widening into a rounded lavender panel that holds the revenue donut with leader-line labels.
use_for: Company overview, ecosystem-to-revenue mapping, business model summary

element: Icon tray tapering into a persona
what_it_does: Reads as a visual formula: three attributes in a tray are funnelled down into the customer group they win.
how_built: Pale rounded rectangle holding three line icons with two-line captions; its lower edge fades through a soft trapezoid gradient to transparent, narrowing onto a single people icon sitting centred below.
use_for: Growth formula, value proposition summed up in three drivers

element: Subtractive funnel of centred offset plates
what_it_does: Walks a population down to the real TAM with signed numbers on flat plates of shrinking width, fed by a grey wedge from the map that sources it.
how_built: Five abutting flat rectangles in one tint, each slightly narrower and centred, each with an italic thin label and a bold signed number on two lines; last plate labelled TAM; a grey-to-transparent gradient wedge joins the plates to the map on the left.
use_for: TAM reduction, addressable-market logic, customer conversion with subtractions

element: Dashed speech frame with a dashed tether down to the last bar
what_it_does: Ties a conditional note physically to the data point it reads from, with the same dash wrapping the label.
how_built: Rounded dashed brand-coloured rectangle in the empty upper right of a declining bar chart; from its right edge a dashed vertical drops straight down and closes into a dashed rounded box around the last bar's value pill.
use_for: Commenting on a final data point, setting up a 'but' that the next exhibit answers

element: Twin logo fans into a colour-keyed mirrored logic column
what_it_does: Compares two regulatory models by giving each logo a fan and tinted card, then running both causal chains through a shared central column in their own colours.
how_built: Logo tile on the left, gradient triangle fanning into a tinted rounded card (purple top, blue bottom); middle: one tall rounded panel with outline, upper half in purple and lower half in blue, each with bold premise, A arrow B row, consequence line and a triad split by vertical hairlines.
use_for: Regulatory or license differences, business-model A vs B when the point is a chain of consequences

element: Ellipsis exhibit headers reading as one sentence
what_it_does: Makes separate exhibits read as one argument by splitting a single sentence across their headers with trailing and leading dots.
how_built: Sentence broken in three: first header ends in '...', next ones start with '...driving' and '...and replicating', with the key verb bolded in the deck colour; exhibits placed in reading order under each fragment; same pattern on Nubank p33 and BTG p50.
use_for: Any multi-exhibit slide, turning a chart mosaic into a narrative

element: Three exhibit cards above an anchoring history footer
what_it_does: Fixes the at-a-glance page into a template: what it is, where it is, how it performs on top, how it got here running across the bottom.
how_built: Three equal grey cards with hard grey offset shadows, tied by a paler horizontal band running behind them; each card one headline, one italic sub, one exhibit (mini table, map with two chips, combo chart); the bottom third is a single full-width timeline; same skeleton on Rede D'Or p8 with roman-numbered exhibits.
use_for: Company-at-a-glance, first content slide of a deck

element: Serpentine rail threaded through hexagon photos with year tabs
what_it_does: Tells a long corporate history in three boustrophedon rows with a real photo at each stop, so it feels like an archive rather than a list.
how_built: Thick brand-green line entering from the left edge and leaving on the right, with quarter-circle turns between rows; hexagon-clipped photos with a green outline sitting on the line; green year tab overlapping each hexagon's lower edge; centred caption with key word bolded below; logos in plain white hexagons where no photo exists.
use_for: Company history with 8 to 12 events, founder stories, merger narratives

element: ECG spike timeline in a dashed frame
what_it_does: Uses the sector's own metaphor: the time line is a heartbeat trace whose peaks and troughs carry the milestones.
how_built: Single green polyline running flat, spiking up, down, flat, up, down, ending in an arrowhead; solid year chip at each extreme, caption and an icon disc beyond it; the line enters from off-slide through a dashed-border grey panel; final point lands on the thesis.
use_for: Regulatory milestones, healthcare decks; swap the trace shape for a sector-specific pattern

element: X-cross brand wheel split by a tinted horizon
what_it_does: Sorts a sprawling brand portfolio in two axes at once: wedges by function, and above or below the horizon by business.
how_built: Central dark disc with circular arrows and people icon; two diagonal hairlines forming an X; horizontal rule through the disc with a grey fill under it; row names at far left of the horizon; wedge titles in teal near the disc and logos loose in each wedge.
use_for: Multi-brand portfolios, M&A roll-ups, classifying acquired businesses

element: Descending drop-line timeline from a root box
what_it_does: Shows expansion as branches of one origin, each later step dropping lower so the eye descends in time.
how_built: Dark root box with icon and description; horizontal hairline under it; five thin verticals of increasing length; date plus two-tone label at the foot of each; framed by a sentence that opens above ('What started...') and closes below ('...became').
use_for: Scope expansion, product history where everything comes from one original business

element: Segmented year column with wedge-linked bands and an exception exit
what_it_does: Lists who followed a trend and then visually singles out the one who did not by leaving the column on a different connector.
how_built: Narrow vertical column alternating navy and grey blocks with years; from each grey block a darker bevel wedge widens into a light grey name band; bottom navy block carries a blue diamond and hairline out to a large blue statement and logo instead of a band.
use_for: Precedent lists with one outlier, peer behaviour, 'everyone did X except Y'

element: Proportional gradient tile pair
what_it_does: A two-cell treemap that shows where an incremental number comes from, large enough to hold the explanation inside each cell.
how_built: Two rounded rectangles of equal height, widths in the data ratio (80/20), each with its own diagonal gradient (slate blue fading light, deep magenta to pink); big % and caption centred in white; base label under each; related donut pill below.
use_for: Source of growth, split of incremental revenue or capture

element: Halo-icon exhibit heads over a floating takeaway tray
what_it_does: Makes a three-exhibit slide skim on two levels: icon heads name each exhibit and a floating tray states the conclusion with its numbers.
how_built: Each column headed by a line icon in a pale tinted disc plus bold coloured title and italic sub; bottom white rounded tray with a soft shadow holding one text block and three pairs of big halo icon plus coloured stat; icons all one line weight and colour.
use_for: Dense strategy slides, value-creation pages

element: Giant logo triptych over brand-coloured gradient card headers
what_it_does: Presents exit candidates as three equal cases, each card inheriting the buyer's brand colour from the logo above it.
how_built: Oversized logos (a logo tile in yellow for the one needing background) linked horizontally with dashed green lines; under each, a pill header in a gradient of that brand's colours with an icon disc overlapping its left end; grey body card with a thin deck-colour outline.
use_for: Strategic buyers, exit routes, competitor profiles

element: T-cross KPI table capped with a diamond
what_it_does: Reduces a comparison to a minimal ledger of label and value split by one vertical stem, repeated under each column for fast scanning.
how_built: Three rows only, no fill; coloured horizontal rules between rows; one vertical hairline through the centre extending above and below, topped with a small diamond; text in the rule colour.
use_for: Three to five KPIs under a logo or card

element: Receding sector-object linework cover
what_it_does: Fills a cover with the sector's defining object in thin blueprint lines, repeated at three shrinking scales for depth.
how_built: Midnight-navy field; pale-blue wireframe line drawing of a transmission tower at three sizes receding left with cables linking them, lower opacity on the smaller ones; stacked logo, event name and rule in the top-left, authors small at the foot.
use_for: Infrastructure, energy and industrial covers without a good photo

element: Circular photo porthole sliced by a pale arc
what_it_does: Shows product through a giant off-page circle while a wide arc in the brand tint crosses it, with the rest of the slide kept dark for the title.
how_built: Charcoal base; photo clipped to a circle larger than the slide height bleeding right; thick pale-cyan arc crossing the photo from top to right edge; cyan quarter-round corner holding the company logo; large white uppercase title at left.
use_for: Consumer and retail covers with good product photography

element: Inverted-triangle photo window with a tilted product card and title band
what_it_does: Layers a dim HQ photo in a downward triangle with the company's physical product tilted over the corner, behind a solid title band.
how_built: Navy field; building photo clipped to an inverted triangle at about 40% opacity; rotated rounded rectangles for the card with logo; opaque charcoal band from the left edge ending under the triangle with title, subtitle and italic event; letter-spaced team names at the foot.
use_for: Financials or any firm with an iconic card, device or product

element: Arrowhead-clipped HQ photo on a woven teal field
what_it_does: Clips the building photo into a right-pointing arrowhead so the cover itself points at the logos and credits.
how_built: Teal base with a very fine woven pattern texture; photo occupying the left two-thirds with diagonal upper and lower right edges meeting at a point at mid-height; logos top-right split by a vertical hairline; right-aligned team and school text at the bottom.
use_for: Covers built around a headquarters photo

element: Oversized logotype on tonal nested arcs
what_it_does: Gets a confident cover with no image at all: stepped tints of the brand colour radiate like a signal behind a giant wordmark.
how_built: Six to eight very large ellipses from dark to lighter green nested from the left, each slightly larger, bleeding off top and bottom; white logotype spanning 40% of width; rule and two-line event below it; team names small at bottom right.
use_for: Any cover when no decent photo exists, tech and telecom in particular

element: Narrow credit panel beside a generative flow field
what_it_does: Splits the cover 40/60 into a sober information column and a textured art plate that adds polish without implying anything about the business.
how_built: Left navy panel with co-branded logos on top, title in the middle and the team with emails stacked at the foot; right plate is a blue flow-field image of thousands of thin curves, generated in code or exported from an image tool.
use_for: Formal analyst reports where a contact list must appear on the cover

element: Ghost logo glyph with contour lines on a red-black gradient
what_it_does: Uses a giant dim company glyph plus thin topographic strokes to brand a dark cover, leaving a clear centre for the lockup.
how_built: Black to deep-red diagonal gradient; huge logo glyph on the right at low opacity in a slightly lighter red; two bundles of thin red curves entering at the top and bottom right; centred logo, hairline and thesis line.
use_for: M&A pitches, oil and gas or energy decks

element: Corner shards on a two-tone vertical gradient
what_it_does: Frames a centred lockup with two translucent polygons at opposite corners, a minimal geometric cover for no-image situations.
how_built: Dark teal to green vertical gradient; lighter-green translucent polygon with a hairline edge at top-left, another at bottom-right, thin rule continuing one edge across; centred title and logo pair; team at bottom left.
use_for: Quick cover or backup deck

element: Centred logo-rule-subtitle lockup on black with edge art
what_it_does: A banker-style cover: everything sits on one hairline in a dark void while the art stays at the edges, with roles (partner, manager, analysts) listed at the corner.
how_built: Black field; blue ribbon image bleeding from the corners; centred white logo, thin rule under it, one-line project name and date; bottom right team stacked by seniority with a hairline above partners; same lockup across the InFinance decks (Cosan, Vibra, CSN-ArcelorMittal).
use_for: Credit, M&A and liability-management pitches with codename projects

element: Moire line wave across charcoal
what_it_does: Gives movement through hundreds of fine magenta lines forming a twisting wave that sets the deck's accent colour from the first frame.
how_built: Charcoal base; line-blend wave bleeding left and right (each line a phase-shifted sine, generate with matplotlib or SVG, export PNG); logo top left, co-sponsor mark top right, credits with bold role labels at the bottom over the wave's calm area.
use_for: Education, tech or any brand with a strong single accent

element: Monochrome action photo melting into navy
what_it_does: Places the viewer in the operating room, with a horizontal gradient dissolving the same-hue photo into a text area with no hard edge.
how_built: Full-bleed photo tinted with a brand-blue colour overlay; left-to-right navy gradient from opaque to transparent over 55% of width; white logo and small title at mid-left; team at bottom left.
use_for: Healthcare, operations or any business where the activity is more telling than the building

element: Double S-lobe panel over a mono-tinted storefront
what_it_does: Separates text from photo with two interlaced vertical S-curves in a bright and a deep green, keeping a soft pharmacy-brand feel.
how_built: Storefront photo with green duotone on the right; dark-green left panel whose right edge is an S curve; a brighter gradient lobe weaves behind it with the opposite curve; centred title with rule, small team line, head of team at the foot.
use_for: Retail and healthcare covers, brands with organic logos

element: App phone on a brand disc
what_it_does: Puts the actual product on the cover, breaking out of a solid circle so the phone feels in front of the deck.
how_built: Graphite background; large solid pink circle right of centre with subtle dark shadow; phone mockup with a real app screenshot, taller than the circle so both ends break out; logos in corners.
use_for: App and consumer-tech covers

element: Icon rail with cross ticks and a lens plate over the cover window
what_it_does: Re-uses the cover art as a section opener: thesis icons sit on a vertical thread and only the active section gets a translucent name plate over the photo window.
how_built: Cover layout kept (navy, inverted-triangle photo, tilted card); left column with a hairline thread and small x marks at its ends and between items; one line icon per thesis, active in bright white with bold title, others dimmed with letter-spaced grey text; translucent grey rectangle over the triangle holding the section name in thin wide type.
use_for: Dividers with three or four thesis pillars, when the cover art is strong enough to repeat

element: Gradient-fade agenda bars on a red field
what_it_does: A simple agenda in which each section is a heavy bar fading from red to black, matching the deck's gradient cover.
how_built: Black to red diagonal gradient background; five equal bars left aligned, stopping before the right margin, with a red to black fill, thin red outline, and bold white roman-numbered titles.
use_for: Agenda in dark M&A decks

element: Comb bracket of reason boxes in a bar chart's empty corner
what_it_does: Explains a rising bar series by hanging its three causes from one labelled comb in the blank space above the short bars.
how_built: Bold navy label centred on top; a thin elbow bracket drops to three outlined white boxes with a blue-to-transparent lower edge; boxes occupy the unused top left of the ascending chart; no connectors to specific bars.
use_for: Growth charts where the drivers should appear inside the exhibit

element: Four-quadrant exhibit grid with bold head and one-line reason
what_it_does: A disciplined 2x2 where each cell is a mini-slide with its own black head and sentence, mixing area, bars and a logo table under one claim.
how_built: Four equal cells with no borders or fills; head in bold black with unit in brackets, one-line reason beneath; exhibit fills the rest; all column bars use the same navy vertical gradient; the fourth cell is a logo table with a gradient header; left edge has a thin decorative blue strip.
use_for: Sector problem pages that need four pieces of evidence for a single claim

element: Project fact sheet on arrow-tipped cross axes
what_it_does: Turns a term sheet into a designed card: three headline KPIs over a two-column key/value list split by a thin cross with dot ends.
how_built: Light-blue fading rectangle, solid blue outline on three sides that fades off to the right; top row of bold KPI label and value pairs; horizontal blue line with small end dots beneath; vertical line with the same ends dropping to the bottom between two italic key/value columns; no row rules.
use_for: Project, bond or asset fact sheets, deal terms

element: Breakeven diagonal with a gradient cost zone and one lone bubble
what_it_does: Shows at a glance that a project sits in the value-creating side of a Kd = IRR line, with the plot field itself saturated towards the worse corner.
how_built: Square-ish scatter with white gridlines; field filled with a diagonal blue gradient from strong at bottom left to almost white at top right; dotted 45-degree line fading out; single dark glossy circle with a white ring and project label inside; companion slide p10 shows the full bubble set.
use_for: IRR vs cost of debt, ROIC vs WACC, single-project reads

element: Three unit columns: mini income statement, wired returns, sensitivity
what_it_does: Stacks table, result and heatmap in repeated columns on dark, with the result row physically wired down to its IRR boxes so the comparison reads across and the logic down.
how_built: Three identical columns on black; white heavy rules above and below a borderless table; bottom FCFE row in a white outline with a blue fading fill; elbow lines from its ends into two outlined boxes (real and nominal IRR) with a small white lightning icon between; below each a white-framed blue heatmap with Kd rows and % debt columns; short broken blue vertical dividers between columns.
use_for: Unit economics of projects, stores or assets compared side by side

element: Return chips on an elbow bus into a benchmark panel
what_it_does: Pulls the IRR out of each creditor's cash-flow table and routes every one along a thin bus into the same US Treasury benchmark box.
how_built: Tables at left with outlined total rows; break mark (double slash) on a vertical rule next to each table; rectangular outlined chip with big value, small TIR and corner dots; thin blue elbow lines rising on two verticals into a glassy panel listing 5y, 10y, 30y yields.
use_for: Bond tranches vs benchmark, multi-instrument returns

element: Diamond-topped flagpoles with italic notes on a price area
what_it_does: Annotates price history with long thin poles topped by diamonds whose notes float in the empty sky above the falling line.
how_built: Pale sage area under a dark green line; thin vertical stem rising from the event date to a variable height; small diamond on top; italic green two-line note beginning right of the diamond; no boxes.
use_for: Falling share price with discrete causes, what-went-wrong narrative

element: Boxed dossier column beside a chart grid
what_it_does: Fixes a full-height left panel for who the company is, leaving the right two-thirds free for evidence; used as the opening page of many decks.
how_built: Tall left card, grey or white with hard dark offset shadow: logo, paragraph, shareholder logo row with converging tree, key-financials T-table; to the right two rows of exhibits with a bold head and grey sub; same skeleton on Cury p3 with an embedded treemap and on Rede D'Or p8.
use_for: Company or sector overview pages

element: Tick ruler with triangle markers and a peer range block
what_it_does: Benchmarks past and current values on a real-looking graduated scale, with the peer range as a hatched grey block so progress and gap are read without a chart axis.
how_built: Key above the rulers: light triangle = 2012, dark triangle = 2025, grey block = peer; one long thin rectangle per metric with dense vertical ticks (repeated line pattern) and arrow-like end caps; grey rectangle laid over the range; triangles standing on the ruler with value labels above; italic metric title over each.
use_for: Turnaround progress against peers, regulatory convergence, KPI gap analysis

element: Boxed axis range with a stem into a note
what_it_does: Selects a time window by framing the x-axis labels themselves and running a line up through the bars to a note, so the callout claims a period instead of a bar.
how_built: Thin red rectangle around the 2025A to 2027E axis labels; a thin black vertical rising from it, passing between bars into a grey box with red border and short thick red tab at its base; italic justified text with red keywords in the box.
use_for: Ramp-up periods, inflection windows on stacked bars

element: Table rows wired to insight headlines with diamond leaders
what_it_does: Connects specific rows of a cap table to the conclusions they prove, so the reader never has to match text to numbers.
how_built: White outlined table on dark with key rows in red bold; dotted white rules grouping Pre-Offer and Post-Offer above columns, same dotted rule above Key Insights; thick red line leaving the table edge at each key row and ending in a diamond; bold red insight head at the diamond with justified white body below.
use_for: Cap tables, financial tables with three or fewer things to say

element: Tall-tile tonal treemap inside a side panel
what_it_does: Fits market-share structure into a narrow column, where one giant dark 'others' cell makes fragmentation obvious and tickers break across tile width.
how_built: Six rectangles in navy-to-sky tonal blues with thin white gaps; % at top left and ticker at bottom of each; tickers forced onto two lines in the small tiles; the largest cell kept nearly black with a single label.
use_for: Fragmented sectors, market share in a sidebar

element: Logo-headed duel table with outlined verdict rows
what_it_does: Compares two companies with only logos for column heads and saves the emphasis for the two rows that decide the argument.
how_built: No fills or rules in body; single vertical rule between the two value columns running up into the logo row; final two rows in a pale blue fill with a solid blue outline and bold blue text, outline crossing the vertical rule.
use_for: Head-to-head unit economics, company vs main rival

element: Curves with gap fill and area anchored on the hurdle line
what_it_does: Shades only what matters: the space between two curves, or between a return and its cost of equity rather than zero.
how_built: Smoothed lines; a pale blue tint polygon only between the two series; second chart, ROE area with a dark-to-light vertical gradient whose floor is the Ke line drawn as a blue rule, labelled at its right end, and the real x-axis sits lower; values at each point with no y-axis.
use_for: TSR vs price, ROE vs Ke, ROIC vs WACC

element: One tall chart beside two stacked
what_it_does: Breaks chart-grid monotony by giving the crowded multi-series exhibit double height and the simpler ones half height.
how_built: Left column full body height for the many-line chart; right column split into two equal cells; each cell with bold head, grey sub; all charts same smoothing, palette and light gridless style; average band in the tall one in a pale tint with dashed upper line.
use_for: Management or financial track record with one busy exhibit and two simple ones

element: Greyscale treemap with a gold-dashed side note
what_it_does: Removes colour from the treemap so that size alone speaks, and leaves the single gold accent for the sentence interpreting it.
how_built: Four grey tiles from charcoal to light grey with white gaps and small labels bottom-left; to the right, a short dashed gold arrow into a pale gold dashed rectangle with a short paragraph; no percentages on tiles.
use_for: Concentration arguments, revenue by category

element: Football field as a table column
what_it_does: Places each valuation range in the same row as its numbers and comment, so method, range, implied value and rationale read in a single line.
how_built: Dark full-width header; row hairlines in pale grey; left bold grey method labels; second column holds floating horizontal bars with dark-to-light gradient and low/high labels at both ends; a pale beige vertical band and dashed gold line through all rows mark the offer and price; right columns low, high, low, high and a comment with bold range.
use_for: Valuation summary with a reason per method, comps with commentary

element: Diamond nodes on a capped rail with dashed span brackets beneath
what_it_does: Shows a three-step mechanism in very little space, with the explanation attached to the gaps between steps rather than to the steps themselves.
how_built: Thin green horizontal line with short vertical end caps; three large green-outlined pale diamonds with a line icon; label above each; dashed green square bracket beneath spanning from node to node, with a centred two-line caption.
use_for: Compact mechanisms in a half-slide, cross-sell logic, incentive chains

element: Rotated-axis heat table with survey answer chip
what_it_does: Displays a primary-survey cross-tab as a single-hue heat table, credited by a form-logo chip with the sample size.
how_built: Row-group label rotated 90 degrees in bold at far left; plain text column and row headers without rules; cells with white gaps tinted by value in brand green; chip of a Forms icon overlapping a rounded outlined pill with bold sample count above the table.
use_for: Survey cross-tabs, product attach rates

element: Before and after ownership treemap pair
what_it_does: Makes a change of control obvious from area alone: same frame size, same colours per holder, the state tile collapsing and a new holder appearing.
how_built: Two equal-size rectangles divided with thin white gaps and a clear gutter, no arrow; consistent holder colour across both (cyan = state, navy = free float, purple = new strategic); % top-left bold in white, holder name bottom-left; a tinted note band with mini logos for governance rights beneath.
use_for: Privatizations, IPOs, follow-ons, post-deal shareholding

element: Slice treemap with % on top and label at the foot
what_it_does: Keeps the treemap readable by making it nearly a single row of tall slices, in stepped brand blues, with only the last slice subdivided.
how_built: Rectangle cut vertically into four widths proportional to value, last column split horizontally in two; white gaps; bold % at top left and regular label bottom aligned; fills alternate tones so neighbours separate without borders.
use_for: Cost base, revenue mix where many items are similar in size

element: Hollow outline arrows between stakeholder panels and a dashed logo disc
what_it_does: Maps what each side gives and gets with four outlined arrows around the platform, the arrow colour showing whose flow it is.
how_built: Two tall rounded panels (brand tint and grey), each with name, icon rows, big stat, optional logos; centre: dashed circle with logo; above and below it hollow block arrows with sharp pointed tails, pink for user side, grey for partner side, with a flow label over or under each.
use_for: Marketplaces, two-sided platforms, win-win models

element: Icon-disc legend column with growth arrows between paired stacks
what_it_does: Replaces a chart legend with round segment icons aligned to each band, and puts the growth of each segment on arrows between the two years so mix and growth read together.
how_built: Two 100% stacked columns far apart; between them per band one thin arrow in the band colour with +% in the middle; left: icon in a disc with label below, colour-matched and vertically centred with its band; small tag above each column for the tiny top segment.
use_for: Mix shift between two periods, revenue by segment

element: Ranked donut row as a survey strip
what_it_does: Shows the importance of independent factors as five mini donuts of equal size in descending order, where a bar chart would imply they add up.
how_built: Five identical small donuts in one row with dark remainder and cyan share, bold % in hole; two-line centred caption under each; tinted takeaway box with hard offset below.
use_for: Multiple-response surveys, purchase factors, independent KPIs

element: Folded square icon tabs on pale pill rows
what_it_does: Lists modelling assumptions as physical tabs: a dark icon square wraps over each pale pill with folded corners.
how_built: Pale lavender rounded rectangle with text and bold coloured key number; dark purple square overlapping its left end, taller than the pill, with small darker triangles at top and bottom right to fake a fold; white line icon inside.
use_for: Assumption lists, four-to-five drivers next to a chart

element: Scenario animals inside bar bases
what_it_does: Labels scenarios from inside the bars with a bear or bull line icon and bold name, removing the need for an axis or legend.
how_built: Three wide bars in different brand tones with value chip on top; white outline bear or bull icon near the foot, white bold case name below it; a thick vertical rule at left with heading and a tinted chip acting as chart intro; comparison reference in a shadow chip at top right.
use_for: Bear, base and bull outcomes

element: Scenario glow header over bullets and range rows
what_it_does: Unifies three scenarios under one glowing band of IRR and MOIC, with the assumptions in columns and the exit variables below as bear-to-bull range tubes.
how_built: Single dark-to-green gradient plate with three bold case names and green IRR and white MOIC pairs; aligned dash bullets in three columns; white rule; table with row labels at left, one vertical rule, a rectangle with a green gradient glowing from the centre with a small base tick, bear and bull values at each end, base value under it, range on the far right in grey.
use_for: Returns analysis, PE exit scenarios, sensitivity summary on dark

element: Logo-topped count capsules above a chart
what_it_does: Adds a mini brand census on top of a financial chart so the reader sees what the business comprises and how it performs in one column stack.
how_built: Five logos evenly spaced in a row; below each a white rounded rectangle with a magenta outline (lighter for lesser brands), bold count and unit in two lines; chart immediately below using overlapped-label bars and a pale line with chip labels.
use_for: Multi-brand companies, portfolio with one-number facts

element: Lit and ghost logo walls in dashed frames
what_it_does: Divides a set of logos into two groups and spotlights one by keeping it in full contrast with shadow while the other is greyed out in a pale frame, so the segmentation is grasped before any text.
how_built: Two stacked 4x2 logo grids; top with dark dashed frame on white and soft shadow, full-colour black logos, a leader line and diamond into the section title; bottom same size with pale teal dashed border, grey fill, logos at about 25% opacity.
use_for: Segmenting peers, clients or partners into tiers

element: Pointed attribute band into a stem splitting to two icon conclusions
what_it_does: Collapses a row of attributes down through a shallow arrow point into a single stem that forks in two conclusions.
how_built: Pale blue rectangle whose lower edge forms a very wide shallow V, five bold attributes evenly spaced; thin line from the tip; hollow diamond at the fork, filled diamonds at both ends; large dark icon and centred two-tone sentence under each end.
use_for: From characteristics to implications, closing half of a logic slide

element: Stem flags over square icon tiles on an arrow rail
what_it_does: Lays out a four-step adoption loop as big icon tiles on one arrow, each step's text hanging right-aligned against a vertical stem rising from its tile.
how_built: Pale rounded tray; thin black arrow crossing the tray; four large rounded-square brand tiles with white icons sitting on the line; thin vertical stem rising from each tile's right portion; right-aligned two-line bold head and smaller note set against the stem's left side.
use_for: Customer journey, engagement-to-ARPU chains, bottom strip of a dense slide
